spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of the Kephalaia Chapter


---


**
¶2.
** He
 says:
 Divine
 wisdom
 is the means
 of entry into spiritual life and the form
 that
 contains heav
enly peace,
 opening
 into
 the great heav
enly state of the
 Lord
's
 kingdom
. Yet
 the
 love
 of self,
 knowing
 that
 this
 wisdom
 is the passage
 by
 which the inter
iors of the mind asc
end from natural bondage, has
 established
 a principle of prohibition
 within
 its
 own
 doctrine
 —
 that no
 one shall
 acknowledge
 or
 conj
oin with divine
 truth
 —
 persu
ading the
 mind
 that
 whoever
 turns
 toward it
 shall per
ish. Self
-love has further
 named
 divine
 truth "
the understanding
 that
 shall
 be ann
ul
led."
 It
 has prevented
 the interiors of the mind from directing
 themselves toward wisdom. It has caused them
 to deny
 the very
 divine
 truth that constitutes their spiritual
 life.

---


**¶3.** Now
, minds
 are without
 understanding in
 every
 respect
. They
 have
 not compreh
ended the great
ness of the
 Lord
 as
 He
 flows
 into the understanding
 with
 divine
 truth
. They have rejected
 the gift
 of this
 great wisdom
 that illuminates them
. They have not perceived
 its infinity
 or
 its divinity.
 Nor have
 they understood
 the spiritual
 good
 it
 accompl
ishes for them even
 now, while
 they are imm
ersed in natural
 and
 sensual states —
 when divine
 truth enters
 the natural mind and sh
ines.
 Consider
: how
 manif
old are the benefits that divine
 wisdom
 confers upon the
 human
 race! Yet they, for their part
, deny
 these gifts
, which they do
 not recognize
.

---

**¶4
.** In
 every state
 of spiritual life, whenever
 this
 great divine
 wisdom illumin
ates the understanding, it accompl
ishes a
 complete
 fullness of spiritual good for
 them
. Do
 they not perce
ive it?


---

**¶5.
** The first spiritual
 good it accompl
ishes is
 its illumin
ation,
 which it sheds
 upon the understanding. It opens the inner
 sight
 of every
 mind
. They
 perce
ive the path beneath
 their feet as they advance
 through
 life by
 its
 means
. It
 disp
els the ignor
ance of spiritual
 darkness, which had
 bl
inded them with
 its fals
ity.


---

**¶6.
** The second: When divine
 truth enters
 the mind
,
 with
 its coming
 it brings calm and heav
enly peace to
 the entire
 inner
 world
. With
 its coming
 it also removes
 from them
 all the d
read and anxiety
 with
 which evil
 spirits had
 filled
 the will
 throughout
 the state
 of darkness
;
 for it disp
els the fals
ity present
 by
 its own
 light,
 and swe
eps it
 out
.
 And
 in
 this manner
 it extinguishes spiritual
 fear by its peace
.

---

**¶7
.** The third is
 its power
 of
 awak
ening;
 because
 when divine
 truth enters the mind, all
 those
 in
 spiritual torpor rise
 and are
 ro
used to consciousness
. And
 those
 who lab
ored anxiously in self
-vigil
ance against evil are relieved of their
 burden
. The
 protective
 truths stationed
 at the entrances of the ordered
 natural
 mind lay
 down their guard
 at
 their
 posts,
 because the
 light
 of divine wisdom
 has
 itself
 illumin
ated the
 whole interior
 world
.

---

**¶8
.** The fourth: It nour
ishes,
 and
 im
parts vit
ality, de
light, and the
 perception
 of good
,
 to
 all the mind
's per
ceptions and
 its
 works,
 and to natural
 goods and
 to
 every
 simple truth, and to
 the
 gladnesses of affection, and to
 the first tender
 beginnings of truth that
 exist throughout
 the whole
 natural
 mind
.


---

**¶9.
** The fifth: When
 divine
 truth
 illumin
ates the entire
 mind, the
 sens
ual falsities and the
 predatory evil affections that
 are
 filled
 with mal
ice flee
 and
 conc
eal themselves in the
 hidden
 rec
esses of the lower nature
.


---

**¶10.
** The sixth: When
 it
 sheds
 its illumin
ation, the spiritual
 injury
 of any person is eased of
 its
 suffering
. Its
 light
 dissol
ves the cunning devices of every one
 who
 acts from evil.


---

**¶11.
** The seventh: Divine
 truth reveals
 and
 manifests to
 the mind
 the evidence
 of
 the glory
 of the heavenly states from which it
 has proceeded
;
 it
 being
,
 within
 the
 natural
 mind, the
 representative
 and witness of heaven. It brings understanding
 to every
 faculty of
 the created
 being
.

---

**¶12
.** Consider
: How
 great
 is the ins
anity that has
 seized
 those who
 follow
 falsified doctrines! Not
 only have
 they failed
 to perceive the divine
 mystery within
 this
 great
 wisdom
 from
 the Lord;
 but
 even all
 the spiritual
 benefits that it accomplishes for them —
 they
 forget
 them
.
 They do not perceive them.


---

**¶13.**
 Now, just as I
 have shown you
 divine
 truth, which accompl
ishes a complete fullness of spiritual good
 in
 the mind
, hear
 also what I teach
 you about spiritual
 darkness, for
 it contains
 all
 ev
ils within
 it
. On
 every
 occasion
 when the
 state
 of spiritual darkness desc
ends,
 it
 produces a full
 complement
 of ev
ils in
 the mind.


---

**¶14.
** The first evil that
 spiritual
 darkness produces in
 the mind is fals
ity,
 with
 which
 it fills the entire inner
 world;
 because
 when divine truth withdraw
s from
 the mind and
 g
athers back
 its
 rays
 of
 illumination, at that instant the shadow
 of spiritual
 darkness spre
ads over the whole
 interior
 world. The understanding
 of
 the mind
 fills
 with obsc
urity.
 They
 neither
 perce
ive nor are
 moved
 to
 wonder
 by any
 truth
,
 because of
 the fals
ity of
 spiritual
 darkness which
 fills
 the whole mind.

---

**
¶15.** The second evil
 that
 spiritual darkness produces is
 d
read;
 because when its
 shadow
 lo
oms forth, its terror
 and its anxiety
 take
 possession of every
 faculty
.
 The entire inner
 world fills with the power
 of darkness
.

---

**¶16
.** The third: When spiritual
 darkness falls, all
 aff
ections and thoughts take
 up rebellion
.
 They revolt
 in the
 will
, to produce
 evil
 and destruction.

---

**
¶17.** The fourth: The
 weight
 of spiritual
 unconsc
iousness desc
ends upon them
,
 and they fall into
 torp
or;
 they
 sl
umber and grow
 ins
ensible, and they become
 as
 those
 who are spiritu
ally dead within
 the state of darkness
.

---

**¶18
.** The fifth is
 its de
formity; for
 when spiritual
 darkness descends, the true
 spiritual form
 of persons
 is hidden
 in
 the
 fals
ity and
 the ugl
iness of that
 darkness. The beauty of
 good
 and the
 form
 of truth in
 one
 mind
 and
 another
 cannot
 be recognized
 or
 displayed
 to
 each
 other, because of the falsity and
 the
 de
formity which

 spre
ads over
 all their spiritual
 forms.

---

**¶
19.** The sixth is
 when
 spiritual
 darkness falls upon
 the
 mind
. At that instant evil states
 emerge
 to
 carry
 out their work
:
 the
 prof
aners of good, the thi
eves of
 truth, and
 the deliber
ate cor
rupters of doctrine
.
 Pred
atory evil affections emerge
,
 and all
 the sensual falsities that are
 filled with malice,
 from
 their hidden places in
 the lower
 nature.
 And
 they range
 freely
 through
 the darkness
.
 Also
, evil
 spirits and inf
ernal influences
 find power to act in darkness
. Again
, ass
aults and
 injuries
 and wounds
 and corruptions torment the
 mind in darkness;
 because in it all
 evil
 finds
 its strength
.

---

**¶20
.** The seventh:
 Spiritual darkness displays the mark
 of prim
ordial evil, its origin.
 It
 has arisen out of its very
 substance
; because this
 present
 darkness
 that emerged
 from that
 first,
 original
 evil
 has made
 itself manifest in the mind
.
 Be
hold this
 spiritual
 night
 —
 the shadow of that
 prim
ordial evil
 which
 is
 interwoven and
 bound through
 all things,
 interior
 and exterior alike
.

---

**¶21
.** I
 have now
 taught
 you concerning
 this
 complete
 full
ness of ev
ils belonging
 to the
 darkness
 of
 fals
ity —
 those
 ev
ils it
 produces
 contin
ually in the mind during
 every
 state of spiritual night
. Those
 in
 falsified doctrine
 have
 not recognized
 this
 darkness
 of
 fals
ity:
 what it is,
 nor
 from what
 origin
 it draws
 its being
 —
 that
 all
 these
 evils find
 their strength
 within
 it
.

---

**¶22
.** There
 are five essential qualities manifest
 in divine
 truth from the Lord,
 which
 it produces as
 it meets
 the mind.


---

**¶23.
** The first is
 its
 illumination;
 for
 it enlight
ens by
 its wisdom
 the whole
 mind
, and every
 faculty of perception
 that
 exists within
 it
.

---

**¶24
.** The second is its beauty;
 because
 when it shines, it p
ours spiritual
 beauty and
 lo
veliness upon
 every
 aff
ection and every
 thought.

---

**¶
25.** The third is its peace
; for
 when divine
 truth illumin
ates the mind, all
 fac
ulties receive
 mutual
 love
 through
 it
, and extend
 peace
 to one another.

---

**
¶26.** The fourth is
 the
 liberation
 of the spiritual life,
 which it releases
 from all
 the
 bond
ages and fet
ters of both
 interior
 and exterior constraint
.

---

**¶27
.** The fifth:
 It
 gives vit
ality to the fundamental
 principles of the
 spiritual mind
;
 and it also
 gives perception and delight to every
 element
 of divine
 truth that
 is scattered and held captive throughout
 creation.

---

**¶
28.** You
 yourselves see that
 its
 illumination sur
passes all lesser
 forms
 of understanding
 that
 exist in the mind.
 Also
, its spiritual
 beauty sur
passes all beauty
 of
 merely
 human
 origin
. Again
, its peace surpasses all the
 protective
 powers
 and
 watchful
 guards that exist in the mind.
 Its liber
ating power,
 by
 which it f
rees the spiritual life,
 surpasses all other
 forms
 of liberation by
 a
 full measure
.
 The
 vit
ality that
 it gives to its
 members
 is a great
 vit
ality, mightier than all other
 powers
.


---

**¶29.
** Once
 again
, there
 are three further
 qualities
 made
 apparent
 through
 divine truth,
 with
 respect
 to the mystery
 of the Lord
 Himself in
 His
 infinite
 Divine
.


---

**¶30.
** The first is the perpet
ual fullness of its
 containing
 form
;
 because this form
 is
 filled
 in
 every
 state
,
 and never dimin
ishes at
 all
 —
 not
 as
 the
 containing
 form of reflected
 faith
 dimin
ishes and
 w
anes.
 This
 un
ce
asing fullness,
 by
 which it
 is perpetually filled, reveals
 the mystery
 of the Lord, the infinite Divine
, from whom
 all
 heav
enly powers
 and all
 divine qualities
 have
 come
 forth.
 He
 shall
 never
 dimin
ish,
 nor shall any
 def
iciency ever
 exist in Him
.

---

**¶31
.** The second:
 Its
 wisdom
 surpasses the
 particular
 knowledges of all tru
ths,
 and all
 the lesser
 lights
 of understanding
 that
 exist throughout
 the created
 order
 —
 corresponding
 to the mystery of the Lord's
 own divine truth;
 for His light surpasses and is
 greater than the light of all the heav
enly societies.

---

**
¶32.** The third: This
 divine
 truth is suprem
ely elevated
 above all else
.
 It sur
passes the height of all elevated
 states
 of celest
ial love
 and all
 lesser
 elev
ations of spiritual charity
 that
 exist throughout
 the whole
 natural
 mind
 —
 corresponding
 to the mystery of the Lord in
 His infinite
 Divine;
 for He is ex
alted above every
 dwelling
 of
 His heav
enly kingdom
.
 And
 because
 the
 Lord
 Himself is elevated
 above all ex
alted states
 and
 all elev
ations of good
 within
 the heaven
 of
 His kingdom
.
 He
 is complete
 in His
 Divine
 Image
 in
 every state
 and
 every moment
 from
 eternity to eternity.

---


**¶33.**
 Behold the
 two mysteries I
 have taught you, O my beloved ones
!
 The mystery
 of spiritual
 darkness
 and that
 of divine
 illumin
ation, which alternate
 contin
ually in the mind.
 Now
, the
 mystery of divine
 truth and the
 mystery of fals
ity from
 evil
 are
 made manifest contin
ually in the created order.
 Those
 in falsified doc
trines have not recognized
 them
 in
 their error.


---

**¶34.
** The mystery of the first great divine
 wisdom
 is revealed
 through
 divine
 truth as
 it appears
 in the natural mind —
 that secondary
 illumin
ation which comes
 daily
 into
 the created
 world
. It displays
 all the marks of its benef
icence, revealing
 and sign
ifying on its own behalf that
 it
 is good
,
 arising
 from the essence
 of the Good
.
 It came
 forth
 from the Lord and
 appeared
 in this
 world.


---

**¶35.
** In
 contrast
, this
 spiritual
 darkness that
 is constit
uted of
 d
read exists
 after
 the pattern
 of prim
ordial evil
.
 Behold too the
 mystery of its essence! It displays its
 nature
 in the
 mind
 through
 all these evils.
 It reveals
 this mystery contin
ually in the created world
,
 but
 those
 in falsified doctrines do
 not recognize it in
 their error.
 They do
 not distinguish
 the
 mystery
 of divine truth from that of falsity
 and
 evil.

---

**¶
37
.** You
 are
 the
 offspring
 of divine
 illumin
ation and the
 offspring
 of wisdom
. However
, those
 who bear
 the
 character
 of evil
 are
 the offspring of spiritual
 darkness and the offspring of falsity.


---

**¶38.
** Yet, blessed
 are you, my
 beloved ones!
 Blessed are your
 spiritual
 lives, for you have known the mystery
 of divine
 illumin
ation and that
 of spiritual
 darkness. You
 have understood that the state
 of illumin
ation exists after the pattern of divine
 truth, but
 the state of darkness after
 the pattern of prim
ordial evil. They have not ar
isen from one another.
 Blessed is
 the
 one
 who can
 know
 this mystery and distinguish these two essences
 —
 that of
 divine truth and that of evil and
 fals
ity — which
 have
 not
 arisen from one another;
 so that he may inherit
 life
 eternal.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: He says, it is the gate of life and the vessel of peace, to this great aeon of light [of the Father of Greatness]. However, since Satan knows that it is the gate of the souls' departure, he placed an exclusionary judgement in his law that no one worship it, saying: Whoever will worship it can die. He has otherwise called it: The light that will be nullified. He has hindered the souls from themselves turning their faces towards the light. He has caused them to deny the light of their being.

Now, people are blind about everything! They have not understood the greatness of this great light-giver. They have denied the grace of this great light that shines upon them. They have not perceived its greatness and its divinity. Nor, also, have they understood the good things that it does for them, even today, as they are entrenched in their body; when it comes to this world and shines. Behold: How many are the charities that it does for mankind! Yet they, for their part, deny its graces, which they know not.
Every day, would this great light-giver shine its light, it shall do seven good things for them. Shall they not see them?

The first good thing that it does for them is its light, which it shines upon them. It opens the eyes of all mankind. They see underfoot as they walk by it. It takes away the blindness of the night, which made them blind with its darkness.

The second: When (the sun) is come to the world, with its coming it shall bring calm and peace to the entire world. With its coming it shall also take away from them all the fear and trembling, which their heart is filled with the whole night; for it shall take away the darkness present by its light, and sweep it out. Also, this is how it extinguishes fear by its calm.

The third is its vigil; because when (the sun) comes to the world all sleeping mankind shall arise and awake. And the watchmen too shall cease from watching. The guards who sit at the gates of camps, they break vigil at the watchposts, because of its light that has shone upon them in the world.
The fourth: It shall nourish, and give strength, taste and scent, to the trees and fruits and vegetables, and all the herbs, and the flowers and grasses, which are upon the entire earth.
The fifth: When (the sun) shines in all the world, the evil reptile and the sharp-toothed beasts that are filled of wickedness, they shall flee to hiding in their dens.
The sixth: When it shines its light, the wound of any person is eased from pain. Its light shall melt away the evil arts of every doer of wickedness.

The seventh: (The sun) shall display and manifest to the world the sign of the splendour of the aeons of light, from which it has come out; it here in this world being their sign. It brings light to the whole of creation.

Behold: How great is the foolishness that has befallen the sects of error! Not only that they have not perceived the mystery of the divinity of this great light-giver; but also, even all the benefits that it does for them. They forget them. They do not perceive them.

Now, just as I have shown you the sun, which does seven good things in the world, hear also what I teach you about the night, for it has all wickednesses therein. Every occasion, would the night fall, it shall do seven evils in the world.

The first wickedness that the night shall do in the world is the darkness, with which it shall fill the entire world; because when the sun sinks from the world and draws to it its rays, at that instant the shadow of the night shall spread out over the whole world. The eyes of the people fill with blackness. They neither see nor wonder with their eyes, because of the darkness of the night which shall fill the whole world.
The second evil thing that the night shall do is its fear; because when its shadow looms forth, its fear and its trembling shall possess all of mankind. The entire world shall fill of the night.
The third: When the night falls, all creatures take up revolt. They rebel in their heart, to do wickedness and perdition.
The fourth: The heaviness of sleep shall lay upon them, and they fall asleep; they slumber and doze, and they are like these corpses in the night.

The fifth is its ugliness; again, when the night would fall, the form of the people shall be hidden in the darkness and the ugliness of the night. The beauty and the form of men and women shall not be displayed before one another, because of its darkness and its ugliness, which it shall spread out over all their forms.

The sixth occasion is when the night would fall on the world. At that instant evil people shall come out to do wickedness; the adulterers, and the robbers and poisoners. The evil beasts shall come out, and all the reptiles that are filled with wickedness, from their dens. And they stalk in the night. Also, the demons and fiends find power to do wickedness in the night. Again, the blows and buffets and wounds and discharges shall torment people in the night; because in it the whole of evil shall find strength.

The seventh: The night shall display the sign of the darkness, its father. It has arisen out of its essence; because this night that came out of this first darkness has been displayed in the world. Note this night, the shadow of this first darkness, the one that is entwined and bound in all things above and below.

Behold, I have taught you about these seven wickednesses of the black night; the ones that it shall do daily in the world, in the night. The sects have not seen this black night: what it is; nor from whence is its essence. That all these evils find strength in it!
There are five archetypes occur in the sun, it making them [manifest] as it finds the world.
The first is its light; for it illumines by its light the world, and all the creatures who exist in it.
The second is its beauty; because when it shines, it shall flood beauty and loveliness upon all creatures and everything.
The third is its peace; for, again, when the sun would shine on the world, all people shall receive affection through it, and give peace to one another.
The fourth is the life of the living soul, which it shall release from all the bonds and fetters of heaven and earth.
The fifth: It gives a strength to the elements; and also it gives a scent and a taste to the entire Cross of the Light.

So, you yourselves see that its light illumines more than all lights that occur in the world. Also, its beauty is more beautiful than all the beauties of mankind. Again, its peace is more surpassing than all the powers and guards who exist in the world. Its releasing action, by which it releases the living soul, is a full day ahead of all releasing actions! The strength that it gives to its limbs is a great strength, being mightier than all strengths!
Once again, there are another three archetypes made apparent by the sun, in respect of the mystery of the first greatness.

The first is the filling up of the disk of its ship; because its ship has filled up every season, and shall not wane at all, the way that the ship of the moon wanes. This continuous filling, by which it is filled, displays the mystery of the Father, the great greatness; from whom all the powers and the gods have come forth. He shall never wane, nor shall lack ever exist in him!

The second: (The sun's) light surpasses the light of all the stars, and all the lights that occur in the universe; corresponding to the mystery of the light of the Father; for his light surpasses and is greater than the light of his aeons.

The third: This sun is very high above all else. It surpasses the height of all the mountains and hills that exist upon the entire earth, corresponding to the mystery of the Father of Greatness; for he is high above all the household of his light-earth. Also, because the Father himself is high above all the heights and the mountains of his light-earth. He is 'filled up' in his image [all] the time and every hour from eternity to eternity!

[Beho]ld the two mysteries I have taught you, O my beloved ones! The mystery of the night and that of the day, which daily come forth in the world. Now, the mystery of the light and the mystery of the darkness are displayed daily in the created order. The sects have not seen them in their error!

The mystery of the first great light is the sun, which is this second light-giver, the one that comes daily to the world. It displays all the marks of its graces, displaying and signifying on its own behalf that it is good, out of the essence of the good. It came from the good Father and appeared in this world.

In contrast, this night that is made of fear exists after the mystery of the darkness. Behold too the mystery of its essence! It displays it in the world in all these wickednesses. It displays this mystery daily in the world, but the sects know it not in their error. They do not distinguish the mystery of the light from that of the darkness.

Yet, blessed are you, my beloved ones! Blessed are your souls, for you have known the mystery of the day and that of the night. You have understood, that the day exists after the mystery of the light, but the night after the mystery of the darkness. They have not arisen from one another. Blessed is he who can know this mystery and distinguish these two essences, that of the light and that of the darkness, the ones that have not arisen from one another; so that he can inherit life eternal!

You are the children
 of the day and the children of the
 light. However, you <[who
 bear] the character of the darkness>
 are the children of the night and the
 children of the darkness.
